LanguageData.Gun_FP-45_Liberator_RWP.label: FP-45 Liberator
LanguageData.Gun_FP-45_Liberator_RWP.description: The FP-45 Liberator is a single-shot pistol designed for simplicity and ease of mass production. While it lacks range and accuracy, its lightweight construction makes it easy to carry. Intended as a last-resort weapon, it delivers low firepower but can be a surprise in the right hands.
